name: 3D Clover
shortDescription: A three-dimensional four-leaf clover that evolved from a dream-catcher concept into an outdoor hanging stained-glass piece.
description: This project is a four-leaf clover constructed as a three-dimensional stained-glass form. It was originally intended to have a dream-catcher-style border, but I later decided against that direction.

The piece uses swirled supports underneath the clover and includes a wind clover and silver hanging elements. As the design changed, it moved away from being a dream catcher and became an outdoor hanging window.
